deny_patterns.name: Infinite loop without scheduler hints
deny_patterns.message: Avoid unconditional infinite loops unless you intentionally override with --allow-risky-patterns. Tight loops can starve Wi-Fi, serial, and watchdog handling.

deny_patterns.name: ESP32 strap pin configured as output
deny_patterns.message: GPIO 0, 2, 12, and 15 are boot/strap-sensitive on many ESP32 boards. Driving them can break boot or attached hardware.

deny_patterns.name: ESP32 strap pin driven HIGH
deny_patterns.message: Driving strap pins HIGH can interfere with boot mode or connected peripherals.

deny_patterns.name: Direct relay startup risk
deny_patterns.message: Review startup writes if a relay, MOSFET, or motor driver is attached. A HIGH at boot may switch power unexpectedly.
